brief:
Nisaa Al-Shams Association has opened an online marketplace to support women entrepreneurs in Bethlehem governorate, according to Palestine News Network. The platform brings together representatives from the governorate, the Bethlehem Chamber of Commerce and Industry, and local women artisans to market handmade goods internationally.

The initiative aims to transform craft production into sustainable economic opportunity for women in the region, connecting local makers directly with buyers beyond Palestine's borders.
